inference.seed_rule: standalone seed = seed + zero-based replicate index
inference.ci: pointwise 95% Student-t across finite replicate values; n reported; undefined if n<2
inference.test: two-sided paired t-test on selected minus neutral raw r; Holm across 84 pairs per level
inference.selection_associated: lineage level only: >=ceil(0.875*R) same selected sign, all R paired, Holm p<0.05, R>=3, K>=3
inference.rhythm: conditioned on pyloricity; undefined if any lineage has no pyloric networks
inference.measurement: Model gbar correlations are not the same measurement as mRNA correlations.
